verdict.rationale: Close documents webhook subscriptions: you configure a subscription URL, and Close POSTs event data to it as events are added to the Event Log, which a programmatic consumer can receive. The developer portal also says you can "stream changes with webhooks." Missing for 10: documentation of event-type filtering, payload signing or verification, retry and delivery guarantees, the subscription-management API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Webhooks allow a subscription URL to be configured that we will POST event data to as it is added to the Event Log.
